turns.user_utterance: Hey! I'm at the store and my card just got rejected! I need to pay now!
turns.assistant_response: Sorry about that—when you try to pay, does the terminal show a specific message like “declined,” “payment not completed,” or “try again”? Also, are you using contactless or inserting/swiping the card?

turns.user_utterance: It says “payment not completed” and I was trying to tap contactless.
turns.assistant_response: Got it—“payment not completed” on contactless usually means the tap didn’t go through. Could you try one quick check: make sure the card is close to the reader (stay there until it confirms), and if that doesn’t work, try inserting the card instead of tapping. Also, is this a card you’ve used before successfully?

turns.user_utterance: Yes, I’ve used it many times. I tried inserting it and it’s still “payment not completed.”
turns.assistant_response: Thanks—since both tap and insert show “payment not completed,” it’s most likely the card payment is being declined. Can you tell me whether the store gave any other code/message (like “insufficient funds,” “do not honor,” or “try again”)? Also, did you recently make any card/transaction changes (like topping up or switching cards)?
